excerpt.zh: 我们的特工正在列出处于[root.target.GetName]境内有潜力成为卧底的人。他们希望能将这些卧底安插到合适的岗位，让他们平日看起来无伤大雅，却能在相当长的时间里随时做好进攻准备。
excerpt.en: Our operatives are drawing up a shortlist of potential sleeper cells within the [root.target.GetName]. They hope to find a set of suitable positions where agents may appear innocuous and yet remain poised to strike for a prolonged period of time.

From there, they will be able to update us on the latest happenings in the [root.target.GetName] and maintain our long-term ability to conduct operations there, should we wish it.

summary.text:
# 推进计划 / Following Up Leads

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`common/espionage_operation_types/operations.txt:154-202`; `events/nemesis_operations_events_2.txt`
- DLC：Nemesis
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

行动 operation_sleeper_cells（准备策动卧底）：成本影响力45，维持能量6，间谍力30，两个难度 T2 的阶段；目标是默认国家，目标国此前没有 sleeper_cell_operation_success 修正；同时只能进行一个行动。

The operation operation_sleeper_cells ("Prepare Sleeper Cells"): cost 45 influence, upkeep 6 energy, spy power 30, two tier-2 stages; the target is a default country without the sleeper_cell_operation_success modifier; one operation at a time.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

8000“追查线索”→ 8001“潜在据点已确定”（选“开始行动”）→ 15天后 8002“卧底已建立”：按目标的特点（唯物、商团、灵性等，权重100/300/100…）随机决定卧底的类型，之后有“可以更进一步”的选项。

8000 "Following Up Leads" -> 8001 "Potential Cells Identified" (choose "Commence Operation!") -> 15 days later 8002 "Sleeper Cells Established": the kind of cell is picked at random by the target's traits (materialist, megacorp, spiritualist, ... weights 100/300/100 ...), with a follow-up option "We can go even further".

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

单线；卧底类型随机。

A single line; the cell type is random.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

无。

None.

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了行动定义与 8000–8002。

The operation definition and 8000-8002 were checked.
